item.title: Kure: Yamato Museum & the Iron Whale — Guide
item.description: Kure, a deep natural harbour east of Hiroshima, was one of the great naval bases of imperial Japan and the shipyard that built the Yamato, the largest battleship ever constructed. The Yamato Museum tells that story through a spectacular 26-metre, 1:10 scale model of the ship, alongside a Zero fighter, a human torpedo and exhibits that deal frankly with the war, the city’s bombing and postwar shipbuilding. Directly opposite stands the Iron Whale Museum, where a real decommissioned submarine sits beached on land and can be entered and walked through — an unusual and memorable pairing.
